name: Classic Lentil Soup with Zucchini, Carrot, Celery & Breadsticks

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice onions.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.
While the onion is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium carrots
3 sticks celery
3 medium zucchini squash

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and transfer to the pot with the onion.
Add broth, diced tomatoes, and spices to the pot; stir to combine, cover, and bring soup to a boil over medium-high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2839 ml chicken or vegetable broth
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
2 tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the soup is heating, peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Trim and slice celery crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Add both to the soup.
Trim and medium dice zucchini; add to the soup.

Peel and mince garlic; add half the garlic to the soup (reserving the rest for the bread sticks) and stir to combine. Once the soup comes to a boil, reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook until veggies and lentils are tender, 20-25 minutes.
Place reserved garlic in a small bowl along with oil and spices; stir to combine the garlic oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp rosemary, dried
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drizzle garlic oil over the flatbreads; cut into 1½-inch wide strips and transfer to a large baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from the oven.
When the soup is done, add vinegar and stir to combine.
Divide soup between bowls and serve with breadsticks on the side. Enjoy!
